about: Reviewed voice phrase bank (design 1.8, R2.2). Every phrase is a complete sentence with NO factual assertion about the product, its maker, ingredients, origin, quality or performance, and carries no digit, number word or currency. The model may only pick IDs. A phrase applies to the kinds listed and, when categories or categories_except is present, only to those shelf categories. For each bank, kind and category exactly one applicable phrase is the default used by the deterministic fallback.
